lines.note: New Innate - Accelerando: Sona gains stacks of Accelerando from using Hymn of Valor}} and Aria of Perseverance}}. She gains 0.5 basic ability haste per stack of Accelerando, up to 60 basic ability haste at 120 stacks. At maximum stacks, each stack gained thereafter reduces current cooldown by 1.5 seconds per stack.
